# Emerald Office Boulevard Plaza

> This office suite is located in Boulevard Plaza Tower 1, a 37-storey commercial tower on Mohammed Bin Rashid Boulevard in Downtown Dubai. Completed in 2010, it is the taller of the two Boulevard Plaza buildings, rising about 168 metres beside Burj Khalifa and the Dubai Fountain, with ground-level retail and cafes below its office floors. The suite provides fitted workspace at one of Downtown's principal business addresses.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Downtown Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed
- Year: 2010

## MENASCO Scope

This office fit-out was delivered in Boulevard Plaza Tower 1, a 37-storey Emaar office tower in Downtown Dubai beside the Burj Khalifa. MENASCO carried out the fit-out works for the office for Cambridge Consultancy. The project reflects MENASCO's experience in delivering office interiors within Dubai's premium commercial towers.
